861:t_085:7.en:
$$朔哉$$
「How do you know about that!?」

861:t_085:8.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Of course I do! I read 'Monthly Super Robot Wars for Men'!」

861:t_086:4.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「This mission was pretty tough, too...」

861:t_086:5.en:
$$くらら$$
「If you ask me, isn't the player the most tired of all?」

861:t_086:6.en:
$$葵$$
「You're right...! They've been fighting alongside us all this time... Thank you.」

861:t_086:7.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Thanks for all your hard work.」

861:t_087:3.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I've been waiting for you, everyone~. I'm rather better at resting than fighting, you see...」

861:t_087:4.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh, no, I'm not slacking off! Moderation is the key in everything. Yes, indeed.」

861:t_087:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Besides, we still have one last job... Shall we, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$?」

861:t_087:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Ahem! '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'! Next time, too...!」

861:t_088:3.en:
$$さやか$$
「I saw you, $$甲児$$! What are you doing skipping your training!?」

861:t_088:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「I-I want to play Super Robot Wars, too! Let it slide, $$さやか$$!」

861:t_088:5.en:
$$さやか$$
「I guess it can't be helped... But in exchange, I'm playing with you.」

861:t_088:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「I understand, $$さやか$$. ...But Super Robot Wars is single-player only...」

861:t_088:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「I've got it! If I pair $$マジンガー$$ and $$ビューナス$$, it'll feel like we're fighting together!」

861:t_088:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You did good, $$甲児$$. Training you to understand women paid off, too.」

861:t_088:10.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... If you were teaching him, just how low was $$甲児$$'s level to start with...?」

861:t_089:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「Good work. Are you calling it a day? Then I might take a break, too...」

861:t_089:6.en:
$$シロー$$
「It's terrible...! I'm so hungry my stomach's going to stick to my back!」

861:t_089:7.en:
$$甲児$$
「Don't scare me like that... Since we're just taking a break, I'll put my all into cooking you something!」

861:t_089:8.en:
$$シロー$$
「I've been waiting for that! Now there's a man who can cook! You're a three-star chef! It's a wonder you don't have a girlfriend!」

861:t_089:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「What do you mean, I don't have a girlfriend!? That has nothing to do with this! Hey! Don't run, $$シロー$$!」

861:t_090:6.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$號$$... Don't you have anything to say to the player?」

861:t_090:9.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Heh... You did pretty well, for you.」

861:t_090:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「But $$號$$ isn't the only one waiting. I'm waiting for you to come back, too.」

861:t_091:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This is a good chance to show the results of your training. $$號$$, try wrapping things up.」

861:t_091:5.en:
$$號$$
「Shadows target Earth. Invaders come from another world. Boundless destroyers appear in space. Humanity faces an unprecedented threat.」

861:t_091:7.en:
$$號$$
「Next time on 3rd Super Robot Wars Z: 'Purgatory!! The Endless Battle!' Tune in and switch on!」

861:t_091:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You weren't bad, $$號$$. Training you to speak paid off, too.」

861:t_092:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hi, everyone! How was it? Next time, Earth is in terrible danger again!」

861:t_092:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「The enemy before us is stronger and more evil than anyone we've ever fought!」

861:t_092:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I guess $$トライダー$$ and I will just have to do something about it!」

861:t_092:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'! 'Save the Earth, Young President!'」

861:t_093:3.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hi, everyone! How was it? Next time, I'll be doing great things again!」

861:t_093:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Earth's in danger every single time! It's a real mess! And our company's in terrible trouble, too!」

861:t_093:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But $$トライダー$$ and I won't let that get us down!」

861:t_093:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'! 'Beat the Recession and the Enemy!'」

861:t_093:7.en:
$$柿小路$$
「President! We have work to do! Presideeent!」

861:t_093:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I know! Then give me a good cheer to get me fired up!」

861:t_094:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「Good work, everyone. Are you worn out from playing too much?」

861:t_094:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「When I overuse my psychic powers, I get headaches, palpitations, nausea, and dizziness, too.」

861:t_094:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「Though as long as evil enemies threaten Earth, I can't afford to complain.」

861:t_094:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「So get plenty of rest, everyone, and fight alongside me again.」

861:t_095:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ and I are fighting for peace on Earth once again!」

861:t_095:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Even greater enemies than before are blocking our path!」

861:t_095:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We'll join forces with our dependable comrades and stand up to any opponent!」

861:t_095:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Next time on '3rd Super Robot Wars Z'! 'Sortie! $$鉄人$$ and the Super Robot Army!' Look forward to it!」

861:t_096:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「There are still plenty of bad guys left! Let's go, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!」

861:t_096:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What's wrong, $$オックス$$? You're sitting down...」

861:t_096:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Come to think of it, we've been fighting nonstop. Dr. $$敷島$$ told us to take frequent breaks, too...」

861:t_096:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「All right, let's call it a day after all! Good work, $$鉄人$$! $$オックス$$!」

861:t_097:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「This is 'Super Robot Wars.' It's a very popular game on Earth.」

861:t_097:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I have no desire to play some Earth game.」
